name: MA-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent running with no serious outside spending
model.rationale: Trahan is an incumbent in a D+11 district with a massive fundraising edge over a barely funded Republican challenger, and prediction markets price her near-certain to win. Fundamentals support a Safe D rating with a margin in the low twenties.
model.watch: Any surprise outside spending or a polling miss in a low-turnout special-style environment could narrow the margin, though not the likely outcome.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Lori Trahan seeks another term in a Massachusetts district that leans Democratic by about eleven points. She enters the general election as a heavy favorite, holding a huge financial advantage over Republican Gary Grossi, who has raised only a few thousand dollars. No independent groups are spending in the race, and prediction markets give Trahan roughly a 96 percent chance of winning.

The main question is the size of the margin rather than the outcome. A Democratic environment and incumbency add to the district's baseline lean, pointing to a comfortable double-digit win for Trahan, consistent with recent cycles in this seat.
